claim: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 and is located in Paris.

candidates.text: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 in Paris, France.
The famous iron tower built for the 1889 World's Fair stands in the French capital.
Construction of the Eiffel Tower began in 1887 and the structure was finished in 1889.
Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
The 1889 Exposition Universelle was held in Paris.
Gustave Eiffel was a French civil engineer known for the tower that bears his name.
The Statue of Liberty was dedicated in New York in 1886.
Big Ben is a famous landmark in London.
The Empire State Building was completed in New York in 1931.
France hosted several major international exhibitions during the nineteenth century.
Large iron structures became prominent examples of nineteenth-century engineering.
The Colosseum is an ancient amphitheatre located in Rome, Italy.
